=== alt else
alt success
Alice -> Bob
else failure
Bob -> Alice
end
=== all keywords

A -> B
end

A -> B
end

A -> B
else
B -> A

A -> A
end

A -> B
end

A -> B
end

A -> B
end

A -> B
end

A -> B
end

A -> B
end
=== group bracket
group Name [Secondary]
A -> B
end

end

end
=== colors

A -> B

end

end
